summary: Retain final usage on uncertain gate release (unit 7e)

rules.detail: Admission remains inactive; limits and the heavy slice remain configuration-only.

compatibility.detail: Successful completion, preparation abort and uncertain release use the same kill, populated=0, usage sample, rmdir effect. UncertainRelease retains the final sample or typed counters-unavailable and the original release error. Fake effects assert sampling precedes removal, including payload usage after an uncertain gate write.

downtime.detail: No live behavior or deployment changes.

recovery.detail: Uncertain release never records refusal or retries. Cleanup failure still leaves the intent unresolved.
